creators.name: Emeka Iwueze (Food-Influencer)
creators.credible: Food influencer with roughly 100,000 followers across TikTok and YouTube who travels to try signature dishes; his documented Cologne visit (via koeln0221.de) singled out the goulash at Puszta Hütte. Verified following and a specific findable Cologne piece; retained as a corroborating creator signal, not a lone recommender. Handle to be confirmed before any place is pinned on his say-so alone.
